terms.definition: The registry root, a subtype of the xRegistry `RegistryType`, exposed as the well-known `SchemaRegistry` Object under the `Server` object (`i=2253`).
A concrete Avro (`.avsc`), Apache Arrow Schema, or JSON Schema document describing an OPC UA DataType or DataSet in one encoding.
A group folder for one OPC UA namespace URI, a subtype of the xRegistry `GroupType`, keyed by that namespace URI (an OPC UA domain convention; the generic xRegistry schema group imposes no such key).
One `(DataType or PublishedDataSet, format)` schema document as a resource file, a subtype of the xRegistry `ResourceType`.

One concrete schema document. In the flat projection a schema file exposes its default (latest) version's document and `VersionId`; earlier versions, when kept, are sibling files linked by the xRegistry `Ancestor` attribute and marked by `IsDefault`. For a DataSet in the PubSub profile a version is additionally correlated with a Part 14 `ConfigurationVersion` (Annex C).
The xRegistry `compatibility` mode a schema's versions adhere to (for example `NONE`, `BACKWARD`, `FORWARD`, `FULL`); a change that breaks the mode starts a new schema rather than a new version.

The xRegistry `format` string identifying the schema language, for example `Avro/1.11`, `ApacheArrow/1.0` or `JsonSchema/2020-12` (xRegistry format naming, e.g. `Avro/1.9`, `Protobuf/3`, `JsonSchema/draft-07`, `XSD/1.1`; applications MAY define extension formats such as `ApacheArrow/1.0`).

The media type of a schema document or a message/transport payload. The schema document media type is recorded on the schema file; the message/transport content type selects the format during resolution.

Raw on-wire schema fingerprint bytes. Every registered format has a deterministic per-format fingerprint (Avro: 8-byte CRC-64-AVRO; Arrow and JSON Schema: the first 8 bytes of SHA-256 over the format's canonical form); the algorithm is named by `SchemaIdAlg` and the per-format fingerprint provider is pluggable (registered by dependency injection).
An Opaque NodeId in the Schema Registry namespace whose Identifier bytes are exactly the raw SchemaId bytes, addressing the schema document for a one-Read fetch.

The optional set of behaviours (Annex C) a Server that also implements Part 14 PubSub applies: DataSet schemas keyed to `ConfigurationVersion`, append-only schema evolution, and integration alongside the Security Key Service. Not required of a schema registry.
